purpose: outcome-blind external gene-group sensitivity; never change the frozen primary folds
mapping: exact mouse Ensembl ID or case-insensitive approved mouse symbol; no fuzzy names or guessed uppercase human orthologs
multiple_supported_orthologs: union all supported HGNC group memberships conservatively; do not choose a favorable mapping
groups: all directly recorded HGNC gene_group_id memberships, including broad structural/functional groups; merge transitively with the existing all-allele95 components
missing_groups: not evidence of singleton family; exclude incomplete components from both train and test in the annotated-only sensitivity and report coverage
interpretation: curated human gene-group sensitivity projected through mouse orthology, not an exhaustive mouse paralog phylogeny
license: HGNC data CC0; fetched snapshot identifiers, not live updates, define this sensitivity
